tools.name: hydracept_workspace_status
tools.description: Check workspace/session authentication and readiness, plus common setup errors. Use when setup, auth, or project binding is in doubt; use hydracept_job_status for a specific execution. Does not execute capabilities or spend money. Hosted requires bearer (WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED when missing); stdio c

tools.name: hydracept_capabilities
tools.description: Browse or fetch capability descriptors (keys, modes, schemas). Use hydracept_resolve_capability when routing from intent alone. List/resolve is keyless; a bearer key may add project-scoped fields. No charge. Read-only. Returns: Capability list or single CapabilityDescriptor when key is set. Errors:

tools.name: hydracept_resolve_capability
tools.description: Match the user's goal to a capability key using natural language. Use when the key is unknown; use hydracept_capabilities when you already have a key or need the catalog. Keyless. No charge. Read-only. Returns: CapabilityResolutionResponse with ranked keys and rationale. Errors: INVALID_ARGUMENT whe

tools.name: hydracept_quote_capability
tools.description: Preview what a run would cost — does not execute, create a job, or charge the wallet. Use before spending when the user asks about price; use hydracept_run or hydracept_submit_job only to execute. Not the same as request_capability_quote (POST /mcp/full) on the full profile (human-paid capability co

tools.name: hydracept_run
tools.description: Run a capability (paid). Use when the user wants execution — not for quotes (hydracept_quote_capability), status (hydracept_job_status), or receipts (hydracept_get_receipt). Default wait=true waits until the job finishes; use hydracept_submit_job when this call must return immediately. Picks invoke

tools.name: hydracept_submit_job
tools.description: Start a capability job and return its id immediately (paid). Use when execution is required but this MCP call must not block — not for quotes or status checks. Prefer hydracept_run when waiting is acceptable. Poll with hydracept_job_status. Same billing as hydracept_run. Requires bearer key. Returns

tools.name: hydracept_job_status
tools.description: Read one job's current status. Use after hydracept_submit_job or hydracept_run with wait=false; use hydracept_get_receipt after success. If the job id is unknown, use hydracept_jobs_find first. Requires bearer key. No charge. Returns: HydraceptJob status projection for the jobId. Errors: WORKSPACE_K

tools.name: hydracept_cancel_job
tools.description: Request cancellation of one job. Use only when the user explicitly asks to cancel the job itself; stopping a local polling loop is not a cancellation. Returns whether the request was accepted, whether the job is already terminal, and the next action. Never promise that upstream provider work stopped

tools.name: hydracept_get_receipt
tools.description: Read billing and provenance for a finished job. Does not run capabilities or spend money. Use after terminal success; use hydracept_job_status while still running. Hosted MCP accepts job_id only. Requires bearer key. No charge. Returns: HydraceptReceipt JSON for a terminal job. Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY

tools.name: hydracept_download_artifact
tools.description: Fetch artifact metadata (and SHA-256 on hosted MCP) for a succeeded job output. Stdio may also write bytes when output_path is set. Requires bearer key. No charge on hosted. Returns: Artifact downloadUrl, mediaType, sha256 (hosted does not write local files). Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED, NOT_FOUN

tools.name: hydracept_jobs_find
tools.description: Find a prior job in the bound project when you do not have its id. intent is recent, failed, or reusable. The list never includes prompt text.
